item.title: Bromley does not feel safe as it once did., 11th September
item.description:
The van has not moved for 6+ months and there is clear evidence that a person/s are living in it. It is located very near a school and it raises questions about safety, sanitation etc. The van is occupying permanently a parking space on a very busy road where parking is already limited during school runs and could be used by other residents, parents and visitors. It is not clear if there may also be welfare or exploitation concerns for the van occupants. As a Street Friend, I would be grateful if this could be investigated. Thank you in advance. P.S. There appears to be a growing number of people living in tents and vehicles in Bromley Common. We would like to be confident that Bromley Council takes these matters seriously before the issue becomes more significant.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): A21, Bromley Common, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
